behavior: AC1: Extract Matched Task ID resolves the exact-key task on every n8n item shape, never a substring match, and fails on a failed search
verification: poetry run pytest --no-cov -q tests/test_n8n_pr_path.py -k 'exact_task or longer_key or no_results or failed_search or emits_an_item'

behavior: AC2: only opened/reopened (comment) and a merged close (done) write; every other event, unsigned or keyless, writes nothing
verification: poetry run pytest --no-cov -q tests/test_n8n_pr_path.py -k 'forward_moving or unsigned_merge or keyless_merge or routes_only or state_write'

behavior: AC3: no node fed by an HTTP Request node reads an event field from $json, in any workflow (slack-task-capture xfail strict, #1877)
AC4: no httpRequest node carries parameters.options.continueOnFail, in any workflow (slack-task-capture xfail strict, #1877)
AC5: the write body is the searched task with only done changed, and the writes read the event from the extractor
verification: poetry run pytest --no-cov -q tests/test_n8n_pr_path.py -k 'update_body or writes_read or write_failure or names_the_pull_request or names_its_status'

behavior: AC6: make n8n-probe sends a signed merge for a task it created and reads back done, an intact description and one PR comment; unsigned forge probes assert status ignored
